name: Desk Pet
author: AlteringUX
description: A small companion that overlooks your desktop from a floating overlay: pick from 11 pets, pet/feed/play with it, watch it doze off when idle, and get unsolicited Clippy-style tips in its speech bubble. Optionally let it actually glance at your screen (via a vision AI) and comment on what's there. Bar icon opens stats and settings.

barWidget.description: Mood/hunger indicator for your floating desktop pet; click for the settings panel (pick a pet, feed, play, mute).
